dz: F. H. C. Society,又名"平发帽会"(Flat Hat Club)由弗吉尼亚州威廉斯堡的拉利酒馆(Raleigh Tavern)所组建. 这是第一个大学友会.
de: The F.H.C. Society, also known as the Flat Hat Club, is formed at Raleigh Tavern, Williamsburg, Virginia. It is the first college fraternity.
